context.scope: Native observations only; no repository edits, no custom metric publication. All24 uniquely owned queues cleaned and exact-name absence verified.
context.selection: One complete final metric response per identity from each capture, not repeated polling corpora. Exact selected operations, input/output/error envelopes and request IDs retained. Replays select only clean request minutes; later periodic zero samples remain evidence, not an exact cadence contract. Local queues are created inside the selected minute to isolate request contributions. Native standard partial receive counts are reproduced without pinning partition order. Empty one-second state probes are replayed as short polls; the completed twenty-second poll uses modeled time. Single controls replay on a fresh equivalent FIFO queue and omit the native receive that also redelivered earlier batch messages. Post-five-minute expiry remains evidence and is covered by existing FIFO behavior tests.

findings.classification: Observed native distribution; do not elevate sampling/failure-path details to documented exact engine guarantees.
findings.size_rule: For sampled valid single and batch entries, one SentMessageSize sample per message, not per API request: UTF-8 body bytes plus sum of UTF-8 attribute name + complete DataType (including suffix) + submitted UTF-8 StringValue or decoded/raw BinaryValue bytes. The same component sum includes AWSTraceHeader system attributes in these native metrics. No MD5 length prefixes, transport tag, JSON field names, quotes, escaping, or base64 expansion were counted.

request_histograms.NumberOfDeduplicatedSentMessages: One sample per successful FIFO send request, including zero. Pure new FIFO singles+batch gives Sum0/SC3/Min0/Max0. Mixed existing and within-batch duplicates gives Sum3/SC3/Min0/Max2. Content dedup singles+batch gives Sum2/SC3/Min0/Max1.
request_histograms.NumberOfEmptyReceives: One sample1 per completed empty ReceiveMessage: two WaitTimeSeconds0 calls and one completed WaitTimeSeconds20 call give Sum3/SC3/Min1/Max1. Subsequent nonempty receive adds no Empty zero; those empty receives add no Received zero.

documented_vs_observed: The metrics documentation describes SentMessageSize as messages successfully sent, but these isolated rejected batches positively emitted size samples.

The metadata/send API documentation excludes system-attribute bytes from total message size; native SentMessageSize includes the sampled AWSTraceHeader components. Do not use this metric sizing result to change request size-limit validation.
The documented five-minute deduplication interval is tested after more than five minutes, not at its exact boundary.

One-minute publication, activity up to six hours, unauthorized-call activation and up-to-15-minute reactivation lag are documentation, not conclusions from waiting six hours or mutating unrelated resources.
